Discover a modern apartment in Antigua 1, offering a perfect opportunity for both investors and end-users. This unit is designed with a smart layout to maximize space, providing a comfortable living and sleeping area along with high-quality modern finishes.

Located in one of Dubai’s most established communities, Damac Island offers a premium lifestyle with access to world-class amenities including parks, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities, all within a vibrant and well-connected environment.

This property comes with an attractive 50/50 payment plan, making it easy to invest with flexible terms. In addition, the 4% DLD fee is waived, allowing you to save on upfront costs.

Contact us today for more details and viewing arrangements.
